prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a two-storey weapon smithy in a stone-and-plaster harbour town on a windy northern coast. dark brown wooden shingle roof red-brown brick walls with stone corners. Windows have small panes glowing warm amber from inside (the only light). a hanging wooden sign with a crossed-swords icon beside the door. A small iron wall lamp next to the door (unlit glass). The whole image is 240 x 224 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: EDIT THE ATTACHED LAYOUT GUIDE into ONE isolated weapon smithy game sprite. Treat the provided image as a STRICT pixel-coordinate template, not merely inspiration. Final canvas 240x224 ART pixels, or 1680x1568 rendered with each art pixel exactly 7x7 display pixels. Pixel-perfect sharp square edges, no antialiasing. Fully TRANSPARENT background replacing ALL magenta, NOT magenta background. Classic JRPG 3/4 top-down architectural view: roof visibly seen from above, front wall flat straight-on. Exact guide geometry in art-pixel coordinates: roof rectangular silhouette x=2..237, y=28..133, with horizontal subtle roof-plane seam at y=75; roof/wall split at y=134. Front red-brown brick wall x=8..231, y=134..223. Keep windows precisely in their existing positions and sizes: upper row x=48..63, x=112..127, x=174..189, each y=148..167; lower windows x=50..65 and x=172..187 each y=192..211. Door x=109..130 y=192..223, exactly flush at the bottom edge, dark brown rectangle, WALKABLE full-height ground-level actual door; NEVER turn it into a window, sign, or decorative panel. Retain precise openings even after adding frames, mullions and woodwork. Top margin y=0..27 remains empty transparent, except optionally a tiny roof chimney. Roof dark-brown weathered wooden shingles organized into hand-placed clear blocky shingle clusters, with restrained warm highlights and burgundy-plum shadow. Wall red-brown brick with occasional plaster repairs, weathered stone corner quoins, delicate horizontal two-storey division, stone lintels. Five windows in the EXACT guide positions, small square panes glowing warm amber from INSIDE, and no light anywhere else. One small hanging wooden sign with ICON of two crossed swords (NO letters), beside the door without obscuring any window or door. Tiny unlit iron-and-glass wall lantern next to door; no glow. Some low-key eave trim and drainpipe. Palette rich earthy material ramps 4–6 tones each, purple-red saturated shadows and warm yellow highlights. Soft neutral even overcast lighting from upper left, no cast shadow, no ground, no people, no light pool, no vignette. Premium modern hi-bit 2D hand-placed pixel-art JRPG asset; same uniform 7x7-image-pixel square grid everywhere, clusters 3–10 art pixels, no blur, no smooth brushwork, no dithering, no noise, no photo textures. One building only.
